candidate_method.attack_components: unchanged from protocol v4: target onset contrast, early/tail amplitude, attack-local high-band contrast
candidate_method.channel_activity_component: For each target-active channel, (candidate_channel_rms/target_channel_rms)/(candidate_global_rms/target_global_rms). Global positive gain therefore maps to 1.0; loss of one physical channel maps toward 0. If candidate global RMS is at/below RMS_FLOOR while target is active, component is 0.
candidate_method.channel_score: minimum of target-onset anchor score (neutral 1 if no qualifying onset) and channel_activity_component

decision_rule: No attack-window, anchor, spectral, or 0.4 threshold changes. Existing confirmation-v2 preserved/damaged classifications must remain identical, and inherited physical-channel/silence regressions must pass.

frozen_compatibility_controls.expected: channel activity component 1.0; independent level/normalisation gates may reject but transient gate does not call unchanged attack loss
transient ratio 0.0 when target is active

reason: The first integrated CI run of the research-confirmed v3 candidate exposed an inherited physical-channel safety regression: a stereo candidate could erase one target channel while the aggregate level/band gates remained within bounds. The final method adds a gain-normalized per-channel activity safeguard. This is a compatibility/safety repair, not post-hoc tuning of the attack confirmation endpoints.
